scope: A selected, portable WIP host-control package and source-bound status summaries, not the private engineering history or a hardware release.
publication_route: Separate public branch and draft pull request only; no direct main push, force push or automatic merge.

executor_launch.binding: Explicit create_session kickoff.model; do not rely on an existing idle App session inheriting the coordinator's model.
executor_launch.admission: A normal reservation precedes the bounded preflight in its assigned public worktree. A later publication contract must name the actual public App worktree and frozen package before any remote action.
executor_launch.mismatch_action: Stop before technical work or publication rather than silently use a different model.

authority_boundary: The repository owner's public-update request and scoped publication-configuration decision authorize this route. This is a public-safe derived context, not a copy of private instructions, conversations or execution receipts.

configuration_differences.public_baseline_limit: Does not contain the later manual USER_UPLOAD source-handoff section.
Does not contain the later required Rev5 mechanical/PCB pairing explanation.
Does not contain the later test/workflow path triggers or registry-table regression step.
Retains the earlier advisory description and lacks the later test/workflow path triggers and required-pair/parsing regression step.

configuration_sources.comparison: The two immutable configuration revisions above; no configuration file is changed by this publication.

required_checks_to_preserve: Check open-issues.md for unresolved CRITICAL/HIGH findings
Check ECO/Issue/Evidence IDs for cross-branch duplicates
verification_boundary: Exercise applicable existing commands on the actual public tree. Do not reuse private-tree results as public-tree evidence, suppress failures, transplant unrelated policies/checkers, or imply the older public configuration has later coverage.
export_rules: Select project-owned source and minimal useful context; preserve UNKNOWN, unresolved findings and limited review scopes.
Map original repository-relative source paths and hashes to public paths and hashes. Archive commit identifiers do not imply those commits are publicly reachable.
Declare adapted or redacted files as derivatives. Do not rebind original seals, execution results or independent acceptance to changed public bytes.
Exclude raw manufacturer documents, uploaded files, credentials, personal paths/data, private URLs, conversations, local run logs, caches and environment artifacts.
Retain USER_UPLOAD provenance when applicable; source receipt does not mean an agent download, latest-version confirmation or technical acceptance.
If a required dependency cannot be safely included, omit or explicitly limit that artifact rather than claim a successful standalone execution.
Only a designated publication executor may perform the bounded remote actions after the exported snapshot is fixed.
review_routing: Local coding work owns new packaging/adapters. Independent firmware and hardware reviewers retain their original engineering scopes. A read-only code review covers meaningful publication-specific software differences only.
unchanged_holds: No hardware qualification, part/topology/risk adoption, physical operation or relaxation of existing engineering gates follows from publication.
